Seminar Fiqh Muamalat Peringkat Kebangsaan 2024
The National Fiqh Muamalat Seminar 2024 will be held on 14 December 2024 at Dewan Agung Tuanku Canselor,
UiTM Shah Alam. Speakers include leading Shariah scholars discussing zakat, waqf and Islamic banking.
Registration fee: RM50 (students RM20). Registration closes 7 December 2024.
Organised by the Faculty of Islamic Studies in collaboration with the state Islamic council.
Posted 2 November 2024
